title: Ilizwi Lokuqiniseka Okufihliweyo
intro: Embindini wenkundla ekhohlakeleyo, apho ukungakholwa kwakungumthetho welizwe, umphefumlo ongatshatanga wahamba ngentambo eqinileyo yokholo noloyiko. Lo mntu, kufutshane nesiseko samandla, waphulaphula njengoko umyalezo womprofeti wahlangatyezwa yintlekisa kunye nezoyikiso. Kwafika umzuzu wenyaniso, wanyanzela lo mntu ukuba akhethe phakathi kokhuseleko oluthuleyo nokuthetha inyaniso eyingozi. Ungamtyhila na lo mthetheli unesibindi?
clues: Ndandihlala endlwini yomntu olawula ngenkani, ndizibonela ngokwam ikratshi elalingavumi imiqondiso kaThixo.
Ndigcine ukholo lwam luyimfihlo, ubutyebi obufihliweyo kwibhotwe lokunqula izithixo.
Ndive inkokheli endandiyikhonza iceba ukubulala isithunywa sika-Allah, indoda egama linguMusa.
Ndabuza imibuzo ngengqiqo yabo, ndibakhumbuza ngesiphelo sabantu bakaNuh, u-'Ad, noThamud.
Ndibuze umbuzo obalulekileyo kubantu bakuthi: 'Ukuba ungumxoki, ubuxoki bakhe buphezu kwakhe; kodwa ukuba unyanisekile, ezinye zezinto azithembisayo ziya kukubetha.'
Ibali lam libaliswa njengomzekelo wokholo kwi-surah ebizwa ngokuba yi-'The Forgiver,' apho ndalumkisa abantu bam malunga namaqhinga abantu abanamandla.

outcome.label: Waba yintoni umphumo?
options: UAllah wamsindisa lo mntu kwicebo lakhe elibi
Inkundla yonke yamkela ubuSilamsi ngoko nangoko
outcome.answer: UAllah wamsindisa lo mntu kwicebo lakhe elibi

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
